subject: Cleanup rain plan question
text:
Hi Maya,

Quick question about the rain plan for the park cleanup, because the turnout was far higher than expected and the unexpectedly good response changes a few assumptions.

Do you want us to keep the original two-hour volunteer window, or shorten it and run three staggered groups to avoid crowding at the recycling stations?

If you prefer keeping one window, I will ask the park office to extend the recycling pickup by fifteen minutes before the first group leaves.

The extra headcount is welcome, but it may reduce the value of the single briefing we prepared. If we split the session, I can repeat the safety notes, though that will require an extra volunteer lead and perhaps more hand signals for noise. I would like your decision by tomorrow afternoon so the confirmation email can include accurate arrival times.

Also, should we send the thank-you note before or after cleanup? With such a strong sign-up, a simple preview might boost attendance, yet a post-event note may feel more sincere. I lean toward a short advance message that only reminds people where to meet, then a proper acknowledgment once the area is clear.

One last practical point: if the ground is muddy, do we distribute gloves at the gate or have them waiting in the activity shed? The earlier reply suggested the shed, but the larger group could create a bottleneck. Please confirm which option you prefer and whether you want me to ask the park office for another tarp.
